interpretation: The online sample adds an independently sourced AC1024-format input and does not reproduce the reported CLASSES error. Keep the issue open pending one of the exact failing RTM files, the missing tenth input, or hashes plus a reproducible BAD_READ_CLASSES trace. Do not infer general AC1024 support from this result.
